record.name: Gabon
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Gabon has a national technical committee on AI and began consultations on a national AI strategy in September 2026; no evaluation body is named.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. A substantive indexed government article describes September 2026 consultations preparing a national AI policy, regulatory framework and human supervision of sensitive applications. Formal drafting/adoption remains subsequent work. The full indexed article was retrieved, but direct and text copy retrieval attempts failed. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded fr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The Lawyers Hub desk-research profile was read, but independence of its underlying citations from the paired national or press source was not verified. It is not counted as a second evidence origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: Substantive indexed government article describes national AI strategy consultation and planned regulatory safeguards. Direct original and text copy retrieval failed; the retained web-search body is the accessible copy.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of the Digital Economy, Digitalisation and Innovation
related_bodies.role: It runs the strategy consultations with UNDP; it owns the policy. This was reported by Osiris.

related_bodies.name: National Technical Committee on AI (CTN-IA)
related_bodies.role: It is a coordination body; no evaluation mandate was reported.

related_bodies.name: ANSSI
related_bodies.role: It is a national cybersecurity agency; it has no AI evaluation mandate.

record.notes: Cited foreign sources for the governance context: Osiris; Lawyers Hub, Africa AI Policy Lab. Earlier evidence was a press report and secondary profile. This partial check read a substantive indexed government article on AI-strategy consultation; direct and rendered downloads failed. The profile lists the committee (CTN-IA) as the main AI coordinator and records no AI testing facility. Searched in French. Gabonreview, which could be saved where the government article could not, reports that the digital economy ministry and UNDP opened the national AI strategy workshop on 28 September 2026, running to 2 October.

next_check.reason: Check whether the national AI strategy is adopted.
